title: Bound joint suffix-density failures conditional on a sparse edit law
statement: On a fixed integer lattice assume P(F subset E)<=eta^|F| for every finite fault set F. Mark t bad if a suffix of length ell ending there contains at least alpha*ell errors,0<alpha<=1. A rightmost disjoint-suffix cover and endpoint/composition/fault-choice counting give P(all r specified marks bad)<=[8eta^alpha/(1-4eta^alpha)]^r when4eta^alpha<1. No independence is needed. This is a probability lemma, not a signed-subset norm assertion; physical fault-to-edit bounded charge, source-index-to-spacetime transport, protected counters, adequate service, stalls and retirement must still be constructed.
